title: isTrackerSpecReview
responsibility: Decides whether an ask is about reviewing a spec, so that flagging it requires the spec to be attached.

inputs.name: isTrackerSpecReview.question
inputs.description: The ask text; it must name a spec or specification for the result to be true.

inputs.name: isTrackerSpecReview.labels
inputs.description: The offered choice labels, searched with the question for a review, approval, sign-off, accept or merge word.

outputs.name: isTrackerSpecReview
outputs.description: True only when the question names a spec and the question or a label asks for a decision on it.
